title: Install Aider (AI pair programmer)
description: Installs Aider into its own environment in your home folder. It edits code in a git repository using a model on this server's Ollama. Nothing is sent anywhere else: analytics are switched off when llmwizard starts it.

uvVersion.description: The uv release used to fetch Python and install packages.

steps.title: Install Python, venv, tmux and git if they are missing
steps.why: The tools run in their own Python environment; tmux keeps agent sessions alive when your phone disconnects.
steps.skipIf: command -v python3 >/dev/null && python3 -c 'import venv, ensurepip' 2>/dev/null && command -v tmux >/dev/null && command -v git >/dev/null && command -v curl >/dev/null
steps.run:
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Acquire::Retries=3 update -qq
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y -qq --no-install-recommends python3 python3-venv tmux git curl ca-certificates

steps.title: Install uv (Python package manager) for your user
steps.why: uv installs the tools and the Python version they need into your home folder, without touching the system Python.
steps.skipIf:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
"$uv" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q " $P_uvVersion"
steps.run:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
rm -rf "$D/uv"
python3 -m venv "$D/uv"
"$D/uv/bin/pip" install -q --disable-pip-version-check "uv==$P_uvVersion"
"$uv" --version
steps.verify:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
"$uv" --version >/dev/null

steps.title: Install Aider
steps.why: About 550 MB of Python packages, installed in the background on the server.
steps.skipIf:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
"$D/agents/aider/bin/aider" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$P_version"
steps.run:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
"$uv" venv -q --clear --python 3.12 "$D/agents/aider"
"$uv" pip install -q --python "$D/agents/aider/bin/python" "aider-chat==$P_version"
"$D/agents/aider/bin/aider" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$P_version"
steps.verify:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
"$D/agents/aider/bin/aider" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$P_version"
steps.undo:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$P_CACHE/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$D/python" UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
uv="$D/uv/bin/uv"
rm -rf "$D/agents/aider"
